title: Feature Access and Locating Functions
summary: This topic mostly contains brief mentions of whether customers could access, locate, or use specific vehicle functions, with a few clear positives about convenience features and one clear complaint about driver assistance availability.

positive.summary: Positive reviews praise being able to use self-parking, vehicle tracking, shortcut customization, and a front camera feature.

negative.summary: The negative review reports frustration that Drive Assistant Professional was supposed to be usable but was not working as expected.

undetermined.summary: Undetermined reviews mention being unable or able to find, order, schedule, switch, or operate features, but the short fragments do not clearly show overall satisfaction or dissatisfaction.

limitations: Most sampled fragments are very short and lack enough context to determine whether the customer is reporting a problem, asking for help, or simply describing feature access.

The topic mixes several unrelated functions, including parking assistance, tracking, display views, tailgate operation, radio use, ordering options, and software scheduling, so the examples do not form a single tightly focused issue.
The sampled reviews are stratified and not representative estimates of the full population.
